pathways.text_002: Skill levels, practice logs and seating, built in.
pathways.text_003: Students move up through levels you define, log their practice from home, and their rankings set the class seating chart. Concert charts build from the same roster.
pathways.text_004: Skill Pathways is the default. Call it whatever your program calls it:
pathways.text_014: Students submit video or audio from their phones. You pass it or send it back with a note, and their level updates automatically.
pathways.practiceCaption: Students log minutes, write a reflection and attach a recording. Parents can sign off, and you reply with feedback.
pathways.classCaption: Seat a class from its {name} rankings, then drag to adjust. Drop a student on a filled chair and the two swap. Class seating stays separate from concert charts.
pathways.concertCaption: Combine whole ensembles or hand-picked students. Auto-arrange by voice part and height, drag to fine-tune, and export a PDF for the stage crew.
